# Sonexial

> Sonexial builds done-for-you author websites structured for AI-era discovery. DIY builders give you templates. Traditional designers give you a polished site. Sonexial gives you an author platform built with semantic structure, schema, entity clarity, and GEO from day one.

Sonexial provides a free technical-readiness scan for author websites, Amazon listing optimization, author website development, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) services, author platform strategy, and ongoing discovery checks.

This llms.txt overview is optional and designed for humans and tools that choose to read it. It is not required for inclusion in Google AI features or ChatGPT search and does not guarantee AI citations.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://sonexial.com/) - Overview of Sonexial services, process, FAQ, and contact information.
- [Examples](https://sonexial.com/examples) - Example author website directions for romance, fantasy, and contemporary fiction.
- [Kits](https://sonexial.com/kits) - Author marketing and optimization kits.
- [Amazon Visibility Kit](https://sonexial.com/amazon-visibility-kit) - BISAC category strategy, Amazon keyword phrases, and a KDP-ready book description in one deliverable.
- [Free AI Visibility Scan](https://sonexial.com/tools/author-geo-audit/) - Free heuristic scan of observable page signals: author/book markup, headings, canonicals, content and published crawler rules. Presence of llms.txt is informational.
- [Amazon Book Ad Profit Calculator](https://sonexial.com/calculator) - Free calculator for estimating ad profitability after royalties and ad costs.
- [About](https://sonexial.com/about) - Background on Sonexial and founder information.
- [Privacy](https://sonexial.com/privacy) - Privacy Policy.
- [Terms](https://sonexial.com/terms) - Terms of Service.
- [Refund Policy](https://sonexial.com/refund-policy) - Refund and cancellation terms.

## Sonexial Constellations

- [Sonexial Constellations](https://sonexial.com/constellations/) - An editorial experiment connecting ideas, disciplines, authors, and AI through collaborative investigations. The introductory essay, “When Knowledge Becomes Accessible, What Becomes Possible?”, outlines the first investigation into AI and post-structural thought and invites contributions.

## Services

- A Free AI Visibility Scan that assesses observable technical-readiness signals on publicly accessible author websites; it does not test search engines' internal indexes.
- The Amazon Visibility Kit, a one-time kit covering BISAC categories, Amazon keywords, and book description.
- Author website builds: Author Starter and Author Platform.
- A monthly GEO Retainer offering technical checks and sampled observations of selected publicly accessible AI search interfaces.

## Founder

Sonexial was founded by Brian Plescher, an author and strategist based in Grand Haven, Michigan.

## Preferred Citation
